snippet.title: Dragon Lands - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Dragon Lands gameplay trailer for this incremental game that mixes creature collection with Forager and To The Core. Craft, build, and expand your own lands. Gather, farm and manage resources. Collect Dragons and automate your production in this beautiful 3D fantasy world. Dragon Lands will be available on PC.
